claims.claim: DBS has a wealth push with an S$1 trillion AUM target
claims.reason: S1 says DBS aims to grow wealth AUM to more than S$1 trillion by 2030.

claims.claim: DBS's wealth push includes 18 new centres
claims.reason: S1 says DBS will open 18 new wealth centres across Asia by the end of 2027.

claims.claim: DBS's wealth push may draw followers
claims.reason: S1 says global banks are already expanding wealth offerings in Asia. It never suggests peers will follow DBS's move.

claims.claim: DBS's tokenised deposits may draw followers
claims.reason: S3 says HSBC and Standard Chartered made the first live Swift ledger transfer before DBS and Citi, so DBS was not the leader here. Neither source says peers will follow DBS.

claims.claim: OCBC is already chasing bullion storage after DBS's gold vaulting
claims.reason: S4 says DBS expanded its vaulting space and, according to people familiar with the matter, OCBC has approached storage providers about more space, with other banks considering similar moves.
